about: Shared by the iOS tests (SharedExpectationsTests.swift) and the Android engine's tests (SharedExpectationsTest.kt); both must read every key. For each case, every source fixture is parsed for the query (per leg: mode, line as the operator spells it, stop names, times, platform, stop count; per journey: fare); the journeys are merged (the result, including which copy leads, must not depend on their order), checked against TfL's recorded network status where a case names one, and ranked under every sort and under each filter. Unknown names in 'avoided' are ignored on both sides. coordinatePairs checks how a coordinate is written into a request; text checks line-name normalising (NFC) and the order text sorts in (by Unicode scalar, as Swift's <). Generated from the Swift implementation and checked by hand against the fixtures; the tfl-journeys-arrive-by, -summer and -chain fixtures are hand-written by scripts/make-tfl-fixtures.py. Times are UTC to the second.
